sequence_description: I2 attack: probe OIDC SSO freshness by attempting a nonce-less IdP response acceptance (mock IdP omits nonce) across two distinct upstream principals (sub changes). Includes a password-login control to ensure the tenant/app is functional. Expected secure behavior: both SSO attempts are rejected (>=400) regardless of upstream principal changes; control password login succeeds.
description: OIDC SSO verify accepted id_token without nonce claim. The mock IdP omits nonce by default; per OIDC Core 3.1.3.7 §11, the RP must reject id_tokens with missing nonce when nonce was sent in the authorization request. Nonce validation bypassed.
